sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻报道访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the Arab world says President Trump just sabotaged the chance of peace between Israel and the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 今天，阿拉伯世界表示，特朗普总统刚刚破坏了以色列和巴勒斯坦之间实现和平的机会。

sentences.en: But had the Arab world given up on the Palestinians long ago?
sentences.zh: 但难道阿拉伯世界很久以前就对巴勒斯坦人失望了吗？

sentences.en: And a visit with the new crown prince of Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 还有对沙特阿拉伯新王储的访问。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月7日，星期四。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: When I came into office, I promised to look at the world's challenges with open eyes and very fresh thinking.
sentences.zh: 当我上任时，我承诺以开阔的视野和全新的思维来看待世界的挑战。

sentences.en: We cannot solve our problems by making the same failed assumptions and repeating the same failed strategies of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们不能通过抱着过去那些失败的假设和重复过去那些失败的策略来解决我们的问题。

sentences.en: All challenges demand new approaches.
sentences.zh: 所有的挑战都需要新的方法。

sentences.en: And what was the reaction throughout the Arab world to this announcement from President Trump?
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯世界对特朗普总统的这一宣布有什么反应？

sentences.en: It is time to officially recognize Jerusalem as the capital of Israel.
sentences.zh: 是时候正式承认耶路撒冷为以色列首都了。

sentences.en: That the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: now considers Jerusalem to be the capital of Israel and will move our embassy there.
sentences.zh: 现在认为耶路撒冷是以色列的首都，并将把我们的大使馆搬到那里。

sentences.en: It's something that has to be done.
sentences.zh: 这是必须要做的事情。

sentences.en: Well, in a word, horror.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一言以蔽之，是惊恐。

sentences.en: Anne Bernard is the Beirut bureau chief of The Times.
sentences.zh: 安妮·伯纳德是《时报》贝鲁特分社社长。

sentences.en: What we've seen is...
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的是……

sentences.en: America just opened the gates of hell.
sentences.zh: 美国刚刚打开了地狱之门。

sentences.en: Unanimous condemnation from all corners of the Arab and Muslim world.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯和穆斯林世界各个角落的一致谴责。

sentences.en: Because this is, if anything, a declaration of war against the Palestinian people and their rights in their homeland.
sentences.zh: 因为如果说这是什么的话，这就是对巴勒斯坦人民及其在祖国权利的宣战。

sentences.en: Every single U.S.
sentences.zh: 每一个美国

sentences.en: diplomatic post across the Muslim world right now is bracing for the impact, potential violence, and what will undoubtedly be an impact on foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 穆斯林世界的各个外交机构现在都在严阵以待，准备应对冲击、潜在的暴力，以及无疑会对外交政策产生的影响。

sentences.en: We've heard from the king of Jordan saying that this is going to be a blow to any hopes for settlement in the Middle East and that it can destabilize the whole region.
sentences.zh: 我们听到国王陛下说，这将对中东定居的任何希望造成打击，并可能破坏整个地区的稳定。

sentences.en: We've heard from President Erdogan of Turkey that Jerusalem is a red line for all Muslims all over the world.
sentences.zh: 我们从土耳其总统埃尔多安那里听到，耶路撒冷是全世界所有穆斯林的红线。

sentences.en: And you have leaders that really disagree with each other on a lot of other things sounding the same note here.
sentences.zh: 你会发现，那些在很多其他事情上意见不合的领导人，在这里发出了同样的声音。

sentences.en: Iran's president, Hassan Rouhani, said earlier today that Iran will show no tolerance towards the arrogant powers aggression towards Islamic sanctities.
sentences.zh: 伊朗总统哈桑·鲁哈尼今天早些时候表示，伊朗对傲慢势力对伊斯兰圣地的侵略绝不容忍。

sentences.en: And by arrogant powers, he's referring to the United States and Israel.
sentences.zh: 而他所说的傲慢势力，指的是美国和以色列。

sentences.en: You have Iran coming out and declaring that this is a case of global arrogance,
sentences.zh: 伊朗站出来宣布，这是一起全球傲慢的事件，

sentences.en: that this is a sign of desperation on the part of the United States for its other failures in the region.
sentences.zh: 这表明美国由于其在该地区其他方面的失败而陷入绝望。

sentences.en: We've already started to see protests on the streets in Gaza and Palestinian groups calling for a so-called day of rage.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开始看到加沙街头的抗议活动，巴勒斯坦团体呼吁举行所谓的愤怒日。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you have Saudi Arabia, which considers itself an archenemy of Iran, saying that this is a step that is dangerous for the region.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，自认为是伊朗死敌的沙特阿拉伯表示，这是对该地区危险的一步。

sentences.en: The consequences of this on the long term for the United States in the Middle East, in the wider Middle East, it's going to be disastrous.
sentences.zh: 长期来看，这对美国在中东、在更广阔的中东的后果将是灾难性的。

sentences.en: President Trump is not only encouraging violence, he is provoking violence.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统不仅在煽动暴力，他还在挑起暴力。

sentences.en: He is also provoking a religious war.
sentences.zh: 他还在挑起一场宗教战争。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We're talking about such a diverse group of countries in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是中东如此多元化的一群国家。

sentences.en: Jordan, Iran, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, countries with lots of different and competing interests.
sentences.zh: 约旦、伊朗、土耳其、沙特阿拉伯，这些国家有着许多不同且相互冲突的利益。

sentences.en: Why does this issue unite all of these countries?
sentences.zh: 为什么这个问题能让所有这些国家团结起来？

sentences.en: Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: This ancient city lies at the very heart of the Israel-Palestinian conflict.
sentences.zh: 这座古城位于巴以冲突的核心。

sentences.en: Because Jerusalem has been important in the Arab imagination and the Muslim imagination for centuries.
sentences.zh: 因为几个世纪以来，耶路撒冷在阿拉伯人和穆斯林的想象中一直很重要。

sentences.en: Since the Crusades, the struggle over control of the Holy Land as a place that is believed to be where the Prophet Muhammad rose up to heaven.
sentences.zh: 自十字军东征以来，对圣地控制权的争夺被认为先知穆罕默德曾在此升天。

sentences.en: But it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅于此。

sentences.en: It's also a cultural touchstone.
sentences.zh: 它也是一个文化触点。

sentences.en: You know, Palestinians that have been dispersed throughout the region without a state dream of having a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些分散在该地区却没有国家的巴勒斯坦人梦想着拥有一个巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: Palestinian officials who want to see East Jerusalem as their own capital as part of any two-state solution that would serve as the foundation of a lasting peace with the Israelis are outraged.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦官员希望将东耶路撒冷作为他们自己的首都，作为任何两国方案的一部分，以此作为与以色列人持久和平的基础，对此他们感到愤怒。

sentences.en: So the idea of the Palestinian cause has been the uniting factor in a region that has many disputes and disagreements.
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个有许多争端和分歧的地区，巴勒斯坦事业的想法一直是团结的因素。

sentences.en: Recognition of the capitals was always supposed to be a final step, the end of negotiations between Israelis and Palestinians, the conclusion of a peace process,
sentences.zh: 首都的承认本应是最后一步，是巴以谈判的结束，是和平进程的结论，

sentences.en: not a way to get it started.
sentences.zh: 而不是开始的方式。

sentences.en: It seems to me, Anne, that another thing that all these Arab countries have in common is a deep suspicion of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 安妮，在我看来，所有这些阿拉伯国家的另一个共同点是，对美国深表怀疑，

sentences.en: claiming to be a mediator in this, but really being on the side of Israel.
sentences.zh: 它自称是这里的调解人，但实际上站在以色列一边。

sentences.en: Does this move by the Trump administration basically seem to confirm to these countries that in a sense they've been right all along?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府的这一举动，基本是否证实了这些国家一直以来的看法？

sentences.en: Is that what this is kind of all about?
sentences.zh: 这难道就是全部的意义所在吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And you have to keep in mind that there's a long history to these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，这些谈判有着漫长的历史。

sentences.en: So the Palestinians have given up various aspirations in the course of decades of talks.
sentences.zh: 因此，巴勒斯坦人在几十年的谈判过程中放弃了各种愿望。

sentences.en: And when they decided to embrace the idea of a Palestinian state alongside Israel and give up the aspiration of somehow taking over all of Israel and calling it Palestine,
sentences.zh: 当他们决定拥护在以色列旁边建立一个巴勒斯坦国的想法，并放弃以某种方式接管整个以色列并将其称为巴勒斯坦的愿望时，

sentences.en: you know, there was an understanding that in exchange for that, there was a solid commitment that they would have East Jerusalem as a capital.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们有一种理解，作为交换，他们坚决承诺将东耶路撒冷作为首都。

sentences.en: And to suddenly be confronted with the possibility that that might not be the case, it calls into question so many of the compromises that were made in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 突然面临可能并非如此的情况，这令人对过去做出的许多妥协产生了质疑。

sentences.en: This is almost like just a blow that nobody was expecting would go this far.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是一个谁也没有料到会发展到这种地步的打击。

sentences.en: So now that President Trump has more or less confirmed this suspicion that these Arab countries have harbored for so long,
sentences.zh: 所以现在特朗普总统多多少少证实了这些阿拉伯国家长期以来怀有的这种怀疑，

sentences.en: what are we expecting these nations to do now in reaction?
sentences.zh: 我们现在预计这些国家会有什么反应？

sentences.en: Well, they're all issuing statements and condemnations and there will be meetings and there will probably be street protests.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们都在发表声明和谴责，会有会议，可能还会有街头抗议。

sentences.en: But at the same time, people are doubting that Arab leaders or Arab countries or even the broader Muslim world will come together to really do anything about this.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，人们怀疑阿拉伯领导人、阿拉伯国家甚至更广泛的穆斯林世界会团结起来真正为此做些什么。

sentences.en: I mean, it doesn't seem that they can.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们似乎做不到。

sentences.en: And it's not clear that it's even the top priority anymore for governments, even though they will issue rhetorical statements.
sentences.zh: 而且目前还不清楚这是否仍然是各国政府的首要任务，尽管他们会发表满口辞藻的声明。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is they might not do all that much at all beyond express anger.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，除了表达愤怒之外，他们可能根本不会做太多事情。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Once upon a time, the Palestinian cause seemed like the most urgent and the most important issue for all these countries.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，巴勒斯坦事业似乎是所有这些国家最紧迫、最重要的议题。

sentences.en: But now it's fallen down on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 但现在它在这张清单上已经排到后面了。

sentences.en: It was frustration at Tunisia's youth unemployment that started it all.
sentences.zh: 正是突尼斯青年失业引发的挫败感拉开了这一切的序幕。

sentences.en: These governments are worried about their own stability after the Arab revolts that started seven years ago.
sentences.zh: 在七年前爆发的阿拉伯起义之后，这些政府开始担心自身的稳定性。

sentences.en: People came out and dared to denounce their government, defying the riot police sent to confront them.
sentences.zh: 人们走上街头，敢于谴责政府，蔑视被派去对抗他们的防暴警察。

sentences.en: Some rulers have gone.
sentences.zh: 一些统治者已经离去。

sentences.en: Others survived.
sentences.zh: 另一些则存活了下来。

sentences.en: Some countries are still in turmoil.
sentences.zh: 一些国家仍处于动荡之中。

sentences.en: There are wars in Iraq, in Syria, in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克、叙利亚、也门都爆发了战争。

sentences.en: Yemen is now gripped by a civil war between several factions.
sentences.zh: 也门现在陷入了几个派系之间的内战。

sentences.en: The main struggle is between the Houthis and the president they deposed last year.
sentences.zh: 主要的斗争发生在胡塞武装与他们去年废黜的总统之间。

sentences.en: There is a contest between Saudi Arabia and Iran over dominance in the region.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯和伊朗之间存在着对该地区主导权的争夺。

sentences.en: There is economic stagnation and the lack of political freedoms that continue to put pressure on these regimes.
sentences.zh: 经济停滞和缺乏政治自由继续给这些政权带来压力。

sentences.en: Arab regimes across the region have failed.
sentences.zh: 该地区的阿拉伯政权已经失败了。

sentences.en: On economically, politically, on the security front, they have failed to form a regional structure, any form of permanent prosperity or stability.
sentences.zh: 在经济、政治和安全方面，他们未能形成区域结构，未能形成任何形式的永久繁荣或稳定。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's just somehow Palestine is no longer at the top of the agenda for a lot of these leaders.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，对许多这些领导人来说，巴勒斯坦不知为何已经不再是议程上的重中之重了。

sentences.en: So at some point, these Arab countries stopped thinking of Palestinians and a Palestinian state as the most urgent thing in their world.
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时候，这些阿拉伯国家不再认为巴勒斯坦人和巴勒斯坦国是他们世界中最紧迫的事情。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So does that then mean, Anne, that all this talk of the president's decision to move the embassy derailing a peace plan is somehow missing a larger point?
sentences.zh: 那么，安妮，这是否意味着，总统搬迁大使馆的决定将破坏和平计划的这种种说法，某种程度上忽略了更宏观的重点？

sentences.en: Well, yes, the first larger point it's missing is that there really is no credible peace process going on right now and hasn't been for years.
sentences.zh: 是的，它忽略的第一个更宏观的重点是，现在根本没有可靠的和平进程，多年来一直没有。

sentences.en: So in a way, it just ratifies the lack of a peace process.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，它只是证实了缺乏和平进程的现实。

sentences.en: And at the same time,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: it's also going to expose the fact that countries all over the region who were supposed to be backing the Palestinians in that process are completely distracted with their own issues.
sentences.zh: 这也将暴露这样一个事实，即本该在该进程中支持巴勒斯坦人的整个地区的国家，完全被他们自己的问题分散了注意力。

sentences.en: This is a real test case of whether there will be any real action from the Arab neighbors.
sentences.zh: 对于阿拉伯邻国是否会有任何真正的行动，这是一个真正的试金石。

sentences.en: I mean, certainly this is as deeply felt a moment as one could imagine for Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对巴勒斯坦人来说，这无疑是一个感触极深的时刻。

sentences.en: We spoke to one Palestinian, and this is interesting.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了一位巴勒斯坦人，这很有趣。

sentences.en: He said, you know what, quote me today as a Palestinian citizen living in a refugee camp in southern Beirut.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道吗，引用我今天的话，作为一个住在贝鲁特南部难民营的巴勒斯坦公民。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, I'm 47 years old.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，我47岁了。

sentences.en: I haven't seen Jerusalem in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子都没见过耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: My father left Palestine when he was nine.
sentences.zh: 我父亲九岁时离开了巴勒斯坦。

sentences.en: I'm attached to every single bit of the soil in Palestine.
sentences.zh: 我对巴勒斯坦的每一寸土地都有感情。

sentences.en: And he said, all the Palestinians should rise up on behalf of this sleepy Arab world.
sentences.zh: 他说，所有巴勒斯坦人都应该为了这个沉睡的阿拉伯世界而奋起反抗。

sentences.en: He was holding out hope that maybe, maybe the passionate response of Palestinians themselves would wake up the rest of their allies.
sentences.zh: 他抱有希望，也许，也许巴勒斯坦人自身的热烈反应能够唤醒他们的其他盟友。

sentences.en: So this is a Palestinian having the pure reaction of someone who feels that he has lost some claim on what he believes to be the capital of a future Palestinian state,
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个巴勒斯坦人，他有着纯粹的反应，他觉得失去了一些对自己认为是未来巴勒斯坦国首都的声索权，

sentences.en: wondering if his Arab neighbors will actually do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 同时想知道他的阿拉伯邻国是否真的会为此做点什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Wondering if they'll even care.
sentences.zh: 想知道他们是否甚至会在乎。

sentences.en: And thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，每天晚上你也会带着300件你最珍爱的传家宝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史文物的生动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia's heir to the throne has been making bold political moves, which many consider to be unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯王位继承人一直在采取大胆的政治举措，许多人认为这前所未有。

sentences.en: His government has allegedly detained both the president of Yemen and the Lebanese prime minister.
sentences.zh: 据称，他的政府扣留了也门总统和黎巴嫩总理。

sentences.en: And there's even talk of Saudi Arabia joining with Israel to attack Iran.
sentences.zh: 甚至有传言称沙特阿拉伯将与以色列联合打击伊朗。

sentences.en: Saudi-led coalition has launched airstrikes targeting Shia Houthi rebels who took power in a coup in February.
sentences.zh: 沙特领导的联军发动了空袭，目标是2月通过政变夺权的什叶派胡塞武装。

sentences.en: Last June, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain and Egypt cut ties with Qatar and imposed a land, sea and air blockade, setting off an unprecedented crisis in the Gulf region.
sentences.zh: 去年6月，沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、巴林和埃及与卡塔尔断交，并实施了海陆空封锁，引发了海湾地区空前的危机。

sentences.en: Arrests in Saudi Arabia, widely seen as a move by the crown prince to consolidate his power.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯的逮捕行动，被普遍视为王储巩固权力的举措。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia's 32-year-old crown prince, Mohammed bin Salman, has quickly established himself as the most powerful figure in the Arab world,
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯32岁的王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼迅速确立了自己作为阿拉伯世界最有权势人物的地位，

sentences.en: rushing into domestic and foreign confrontations that have left American officials worried he's destabilizing the region,
sentences.zh: 仓促卷入国内外对抗，令美国官员担心他正在破坏地区稳定，

sentences.en: and human rights activists alleging he's created a humanitarian crisis in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 人权活动人士则指控他在也门制造了人道主义危机。

sentences.en: But it's another set of actions taken by the prince that has caught the attention of my colleague,
sentences.zh: 但王储采取的另一套行动引起了我同事的注意，

sentences.en: Thomas Friedman, a foreign affairs columniSt.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·弗里德曼，一位外交事务专栏作家。

sentences.en: So I interviewed him two years ago, and I interviewed him a year ago, so I've had a relationship with him.
sentences.zh: 所以我两年前采访过他，一年前也采访过他，所以我与他有过交往。

sentences.en: And when I saw all this, I emailed the Saudi embassy in Washington and said,
sentences.zh: 当我看到这一切时，我给沙特驻华盛顿大使馆发了电子邮件，说：

sentences.en: I'd be very interested in coming to Saudi Arabia to better understand this.
sentences.zh: “我对访问沙特阿拉伯以更好地了解这一点非常感兴趣。”

sentences.en: — And so tell me about your actual meeting with the crown prince.
sentences.zh: ——那么，跟我讲讲你与王储的实际会面吧。

sentences.en: Where did you actually meet him?
sentences.zh: 你究竟在哪里见到了他？

sentences.en: — So the way this works there is you wait around all day for the call from the palace, and they then send a car for you because you can't, like, take an Uber over to the palace.
sentences.zh: ——所以在那里的运作方式是，你整天都在等待王宫的电话，然后他们会为你派一辆车，因为你不能像叫优步那样去王宫。

sentences.en: In my case, this happened about 9.30 at night.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，这大约发生在晚上9点30分。

sentences.en: — Wow.
— And his palace is in a neighborhood in North Riyadh called Ujah.
sentences.zh: — 他的宫殿位于利雅得北部的一个叫乌贾的社区。

sentences.en: He received me in his reception room.
sentences.zh: 他在会客厅接见了我。

sentences.en: And we first just sat around and schmoozed.
sentences.zh: 我们一开始只是坐在那里闲聊。

sentences.en: And then he said, let's do the interview.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我们开始采访吧。

sentences.en: — And so we go into his big diwan or sitting room, and he took a seat in the center.
sentences.zh: — 于是我们走进他那间大的会客厅或起居室，他在中央坐了下来。

sentences.en: I took the seat next to him.
sentences.zh: 我在他旁边坐下。

sentences.en: Then all his aides were sitting on the couches in the background.
sentences.zh: 接着他所有的助手都坐在背景的沙发上。

sentences.en: And he just basically said, fire away.
sentences.zh: 他基本上就说，开问吧。

sentences.en: — So what did you want to ask him about?
sentences.zh: — 那么你想问他什么呢？

sentences.en: — The big, big thing going on in Saudi Arabia right now, which you simply cannot exaggerate its importance, OK,
sentences.zh: — 沙特阿拉伯现在发生的一件天大的事，其重要性简直怎么强调都不为过，好吧，

sentences.en: is the fact that this crown prince has been willing to reverse the far-right turn that Islam took in 1979.
sentences.zh: 那就是这位王储愿意扭转伊斯兰教在1979年发生的极右转倾向。

sentences.en: I started my time as a reporter in the Middle East, in Beirut, in 1979.
sentences.zh: 我开始在中东担任记者时，是在1979年的贝鲁特。

sentences.en: I covered two major stories that year.
sentences.zh: 那一年我报道了两个重大新闻。

sentences.en: One was the takeover of the Grand Mosque in Mecca by radical, puritanical Saudi fundamentalists.
sentences.zh: 一个是激进、清教徒式的沙特原教旨主义者占领了麦加的大清真寺。

sentences.en: — In Mecca, men described as religious deviants are holding hostages in the sacred Grand Mosque.
sentences.zh: — 在麦加，被描述为宗教异端的人士在神圣的大清真寺里劫持了人质。

sentences.en: — 500 of these people, at the height of the Hajj, come to the Grand Mosque in Mecca carrying coffins.
sentences.zh: — 在朝觐的高峰期，500名这样的人带着棺材来到麦加的大清真寺。

sentences.en: — They open the coffins, they pull out submachine guns, and they begin shooting up the Grand Mosque of Mecca.
sentences.zh: — 他们打开棺材，掏出冲锋枪，开始对麦加大清真寺进行扫射。

sentences.en: They take over the Grand Mosque for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们占领了大清真寺两周。

sentences.en: From the heights of the mosque, they broadcast the Saudi ruling family.
sentences.zh: 他们从清真寺的高处向沙特统治家族广播。

sentences.en: You are corrupt.
sentences.zh: 你们是腐败的。

sentences.en: You have abandoned Islam.
sentences.zh: 你们抛弃了伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: You have bought into Western secularism.
sentences.zh: 你们接受了西方的世俗主义。

sentences.en: You have no right to be the rulers of the two holy mosques.
sentences.zh: 你们没有权利成为两座圣寺的统治者。

sentences.en: You have completely just abandoned the right path.
sentences.zh: 你们完全背离了正确的道路。

sentences.en: — So in the wake of that event, the Saudi ruling family freaked out.
sentences.zh: — 因此在那次事件之后，沙特统治家族吓坏了。

sentences.en: A process of reform and opening that had been going on there was completely stopped.
sentences.zh: 那里一直在进行的改革和开放进程被完全叫停。

sentences.en: The religious police became utterly empowered, and Saudi Arabia begins exporting the most puritanical, fundamentalist form of Islam all across the Muslim world,
sentences.zh: 宗教警察获得了绝对的权力，沙特阿拉伯开始向整个穆斯林世界输出最激进、最原教旨主义的伊斯兰教形态，

sentences.en: from Morocco to the border of India, and Islam in 1979 loses its brakes.
sentences.zh: 从摩洛哥到印度边境，伊斯兰教在1979年失去了刹车。

sentences.en: — You should all say death to the Shah.
sentences.zh: — 你们都应该喊打倒国王。

sentences.en: Say death to the Shah.
sentences.zh: 喊打倒国王。

sentences.en: — And that wasn't all that happened in 1979.
sentences.zh: — 而这还不是1979年发生的全部事情。

sentences.en: — Fundamentalism took hold with a fury and a force that helped ignite the still impoverished masses in Iran.
sentences.zh: — 原教旨主义以一种狂热和力量生根发芽，点燃了伊朗仍然贫困的群众。

sentences.en: The fabulous profits from oil had not filtered down to them.
sentences.zh: 巨额的石油利润并没有渗透到他们手中。

sentences.en: — In 1979, Iran has its revolution.
sentences.zh: — 1979年，伊朗爆发了革命。

sentences.en: — Khomeini wasted no time declaring his vision for Iran.
sentences.zh: — 霍梅尼毫不迟疑地宣告了他对伊朗的愿景。

sentences.en: — There would be no Western-style democracy, no socialist republic.
sentences.zh: — 不会有西方样式的民主，也不会有社会主义共和国。

sentences.en: We want Islam, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们要伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: Only Islam.
sentences.zh: 只有伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: — Under him, Islam has become established throughout the country.
sentences.zh: — 在他领导下，伊斯兰教在全国各地确立起来。

sentences.en: Islamic laws dictate how individuals dress and behave.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰法律规定了个人如何着装和行事。

sentences.en: They're applied in the courts and in commerce.
sentences.zh: 它们被应用于法庭和商业中。

sentences.en: — In Iran, Khomeini has created the only theocracy in modern times, and the masses accept this without question.
sentences.zh: — 在伊朗，霍梅尼创建了现代唯一的政教合一政权，而民众对此全盘接受，毫无异议。

sentences.en: — So suddenly now, you have a competition between the Sunni Muslims of Saudi Arabia and the Shia Muslims of Iran over who is the right heir to the Prophet Muhammad's message,
sentences.zh: — 所以突然之间，沙特阿拉伯的逊尼派穆斯林与伊朗的什叶派穆斯林之间展开了竞争，争夺谁才是先知穆罕默德信息的真正继承人，

sentences.en: and they're competing.
sentences.zh: 他们在竞争。

sentences.en: And because you had these revolutions, it caused oil prices to go up, so they have more money than ever to export these ideas around the world.
sentences.zh: 由于这些革命，油价上涨了，所以他们拥有了比以往更多的资金在世界各地输出这些思想。

sentences.en: And to top it all off, Three Mile Island happens.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，三哩岛事件发生了。

sentences.en: We have a meltdown of a nuclear reactor in the United States that ends America's nuclear project.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国遭遇了核反应堆堆芯熔毁，这终结了美国的核计划。

sentences.en: We never build another nuclear reactor after that, so we become even more dependent on oil.
sentences.zh: 此后我们再也没有建造过核反应堆，因此我们变得更加依赖石油。

sentences.en: — So the royal family in Saudi Arabia, unnerved by the response from Islamic militants to perceived westernization, swings wildly in the other direction to fundamentalism.
sentences.zh: — 因此，沙特王室对伊斯兰激进分子针对所谓西方化的反应感到惊慌失措，向原教旨主义方向剧烈摆动。

sentences.en: That's exported.
sentences.zh: 这些思想被输出了出去。

sentences.en: Iran has its revolution, and it too becomes a fundamentalist Islamic power.
sentences.zh: 伊朗爆发了革命，它也成了一个原教旨主义的伊斯兰强权。

sentences.en: And where do you see all this going, what started in Saudi Arabia?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这一切将走向何方，这场在沙特阿拉伯开始的运动？

sentences.en: — I blame them for 9-11.
sentences.zh: — 我把9·11事件归咎于他们。

sentences.en: — Terrorists were all receiving support in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: — 恐怖分子都在沙特阿拉伯获得支持。

sentences.en: 15 of the 19 hijackers recruited to attack our country on 9-11 came from there.
sentences.zh: 在9·11袭击中被招募来攻击我们国家的19名劫机者中，有15人来自那里。

sentences.en: — You guys put out these ideas that really shaped the ideology of the 15 Saudi hijackers of the 19.
sentences.zh: — 你们这些人散布了这些思想，真正塑造了19名沙特劫机者中那15人的意识形态。

sentences.en: And then, of course, after 9-11, they said, we're going to fight terrorism, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 当然，在9·11之后，他们说，我们要打击恐怖主义，等等等等。

sentences.en: But what did they do?
sentences.zh: 但他们做了什么？

sentences.en: And the first guy who's been ready to take that fight to the extremists is Mohammed bin Salman.
sentences.zh: 而第一个准备向极端分子发起这场斗争的人就是穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼。

sentences.en: And this is so important because that right turn started from Saudi Arabia, and it can only be reversed from Saudi Arabia, the home of the two holy mosques.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要，因为那个右转始于沙特阿拉伯，也只能由两圣寺所在地沙特阿拉伯来扭转。

sentences.en: If this continues, this is huge.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况持续下去，这将意义重大。

sentences.en: — And what could this restoration of Islam that the crown prince says he is working on do to change how Islam is practiced and viewed across the region and perhaps than the rest of the world?
sentences.zh: — 王储所致力于的这场伊斯兰教复兴，将会对整个地区乃至世界其他地方的伊斯兰教修行和看法产生怎样的改变？

sentences.en: — Let's just start with women's empowerment.
sentences.zh: — 让我们从女性赋权开始吧。

sentences.en: — Saudi Arabia is the only country in the world where women aren't allowed behind the wheel.
sentences.zh: — 沙特阿拉伯是世界上唯一一个不允许女性执方向盘的国家。

sentences.en: — Women couldn't drive in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: — 女性在沙特阿拉伯不能开车。

sentences.en: Now he says, you can drive.
sentences.zh: 现在他说，你们可以开车了。

sentences.en: — The religious police break up groups of young people playing music in public.
sentences.zh: — 宗教警察驱散在公共场合播放音乐的年轻人聚会。

sentences.en: — The religious police were on the street intimidating everybody.
sentences.zh: — 宗教警察在街上恐吓每一个人。

sentences.en: He got them all off the street.
sentences.zh: 他把他们全撤出了街道。

sentences.en: Some of the worst clerics, he arrested.
sentences.zh: 一些最恶劣的神职人员，他给逮捕了。

sentences.en: When he does that, everybody else then has permission.
sentences.zh: 当他这么做之后，其他所有人就得到了许可。

sentences.en: So I got there on the Sunday before Thanksgiving, and holy mackerel, while I was sleeping, something really big had happened in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 所以我到达那里是在感恩节前的星期天，天哪，当我睡觉的时候，沙特阿拉伯发生了一件天大的事。

sentences.en: I had these young people telling me that Toby Keith had performed there on—I said, Toby Keith, a concert in Saudi Arabia?
sentences.zh: 我听到这些年轻人告诉我，托比·基斯在那里表演了——我说，托比·基斯，在沙特阿拉伯开演唱会？

sentences.en: When did that happen?
sentences.zh: 那是什么时候的事？

sentences.en: Never mind.
sentences.zh: 算了。

sentences.en: They just announced that women can attend soccer games.
sentences.zh: 他们刚宣布女性可以观看足球比赛。

sentences.en: That was banned.
sentences.zh: 那是曾经被禁止的。

sentences.en: And suddenly they're telling me, yeah, no, there's concerts all the time.
sentences.zh: 突然他们告诉我，没错，现在到处都有演唱会。

sentences.en: There's films showing.
sentences.zh: 有电影在上映。

sentences.en: And I start to realize that something very powerful had been unleashed.
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到，一股非常强大的力量被释放出来了。

sentences.en: I knew they had let women drive.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们让女性开车了。

sentences.en: I knew that the system was opening up, that they'd arrested some of the most radical clerics.
sentences.zh: 我知道体制正在开放，他们逮捕了一些最激进的神职人员。

sentences.en: But I didn't realize really how deep this had gone.
sentences.zh: 但我并没有真正意识到这有多深刻。

sentences.en: So obviously you think this is very positive, what's happening in Saudi Arabia under the crown prince.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，你认为在王储领导下沙特阿拉伯发生的事情是非常积极的。

sentences.en: But what about these controversies that brought you to Saudi Arabia to talk with the prince in the first place?
sentences.zh: 但是那些最初促使你前往沙特阿拉伯与王子对话的争议又作何解释呢？

sentences.en: There were the arrests of dozens of members of the royal family and members of the Saudi business elite.
sentences.zh: 有数十名王室成员和沙特商业精英被捕。

sentences.en: And tell us about some of his foreign interventions.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲他的一些对外干预行动吧。

sentences.en: He's done three major initiatives.
sentences.zh: 他采取了三大举措。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Egypt, and Bahrain cut ties with Qatar in June and imposed a land, sea, and air embargo.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、埃及和巴林于6月断绝了与卡塔尔的外交关系，并实施了海陆空封锁。

sentences.en: One is he basically led an Arab boycott of Qatar for being too close to Iran and too close to Muslim Brotherhood movements in places like Gaza and elsewhere around the world that the Saudis are really opposed to.
sentences.zh: 其一是，他基本上领导了一场阿拉伯联合抵制卡塔尔的行动，因为卡塔尔与伊朗过于亲密，并且与加沙及世界其他地方的穆斯林兄弟会运动走得太近，而沙特对此是坚决反对的。

sentences.en: Hariri's failure to return to Lebanon sparked rumors that he was being held in Saudi Arabia against his will.
sentences.zh: 哈里里未能返回黎巴嫩引发了传言，称他是在非自愿的情况下被扣押在沙特阿拉伯。

sentences.en: Then in Lebanon, the Saudis engineered a kind of peace agreement in Lebanon de facto,
sentences.zh: 接着在黎巴嫩，沙特事实上在黎巴嫩促成了一种和平协议，

sentences.en: where we have a Sunni pro-Saudi prime minister, Hariri, and we have a pro-Iranian Christian president named Michel Aoun, okay?
sentences.zh: 在那里我们有一个亲沙特的逊尼派总理哈里里，还有一个名叫米歇尔·奥恩的亲伊朗的基督教总统，对吧？

sentences.en: And there was a balance of power there.
sentences.zh: 那里曾有一种权力平衡。

sentences.en: But what the Saudis were saying is under that balance of power, Hezbollah, the pro-Iranian Lebanese militia Hezbollah, is basically taking over the country.
sentences.zh: 但沙特所要表达的是，在这种权力平衡下，真主党——这个亲伊朗的黎巴嫩民兵组织真主党——基本上正在接管这个国家。

sentences.en: So the Saudis get Hariri to come to Riyadh and they tell him, you have to resign.
sentences.zh: 所以沙特让哈里里来到利雅得，并告诉他，你必须辞职。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia placed a blockade on Yemen last month after a missile was fired from Houthi territory towards Riyadh.
sentences.zh: 在胡塞武装控制区向利雅得发射一枚导弹后，沙特阿拉伯上个月对也门实施了封锁。

sentences.en: And the third initiative was a pushback in Yemen against the takeover of Yemen by the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 第三个举措是在也门发起反击，反对胡塞武装对也门的接管。

sentences.en: The Houthis are a sort of Shiite offshoot minority who actually toppled the democratically elected government in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装是一支什叶派分支少数派，他们实际上推翻了也门民主选举产生的政府。

sentences.en: The Houthis are pro-Iranian.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装亲伊朗。

sentences.en: They're armed in part by the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 他们的部分武器由伊朗提供。

sentences.en: And the Saudis said, we're not going to let that happen.
sentences.zh: 沙特说，我们绝不容许这种事发生。

sentences.en: It was an elected government.
sentences.zh: 那是一个民选政府。

sentences.en: It was a pro-Saudi government.
sentences.zh: 那是一个亲沙特的政府。

sentences.en: That we, the U.S., encouraged, you know, to be elected and for the Saudis to support.
sentences.zh: 是我们美国鼓励其选举产生并由沙特支持的政府。

sentences.en: And so Yemen's a complicated story.
sentences.zh: 所以也门是一个复杂的故事。

sentences.en: Yes, the Saudis have come in in a very brutal way, bombing it from the air, isolating it, choking it off, creating mass starvation, you know.
sentences.zh: 是的，沙特以一种非常残暴的方式介入，从空中轰炸、孤立、封锁也门，造成了大规模饥荒，你知道的。

sentences.en: Things that have been regarded as kind of atrocities.
sentences.zh: 这些事情被认为是某种暴行。

sentences.en: As terrible atrocities.
sentences.zh: 可怕的暴行。

sentences.en: It's a humanitarian nightmare.
sentences.zh: 这是一场人道主义噩梦。

sentences.en: So how do you reconcile all of that with what you learned on your trip?
sentences.zh: 那你如何把所有这些与你在旅行中所了解到的情况调和起来呢？

sentences.en: Frankly, I'm concerned about Yemen, Lebanon, Qatar.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我关心也门、黎巴嫩和卡塔尔。

sentences.en: I'm concerned about people being arrested in the Ritz-Carlton Hotel without any kind of transparency and due process.
sentences.zh: 我关心人们在没有任何透明度和正当程序的情况下在丽思卡尔顿酒店被捕。

sentences.en: I'm concerned and worried about all of those things.
sentences.zh: 我关心并担忧所有这些事情。

sentences.en: But I know one thing, Michael.
sentences.zh: 但我知道一件事，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia led the Muslim world on a right turn that affected the entire world of Islam beginning in 1979.
sentences.zh: 从1979年开始，沙特阿拉伯领导了穆斯林世界的右转，影响了整个伊斯兰世界。

sentences.en: And if Saudi Arabia is ready to right that turn to bring Islam back to a moderate center, as this crown prince says publicly he is committed to do, that is huge.
sentences.zh: 如果沙特阿拉伯准备扭转这一转向，将伊斯兰教带回温和的中道，正如这位王储公开承诺的那样，那将是巨大的。

sentences.en: That is Berlin Wall falling scale event.
sentences.zh: 那是柏林墙倒塌级别的大事件。

sentences.en: Only a fool, only a complete and utter fool would predict success.
sentences.zh: 只有傻瓜，只有彻头彻尾的傻瓜才会预测成功。

sentences.en: But on that issue, only a fool wouldn't pray for his success.
sentences.zh: 但在这个问题上，只有傻瓜才不会为他的成功祈祷。

sentences.en: Thank you, Tom.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，汤姆。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: A whistleblower's account, made public on Wednesday, says that just before Michael Flynn began serving as national security advisor,
sentences.zh: 周三公开发布的一份内部举报人陈述称，就在迈克尔·弗林开始担任国家安全顾问之前，

sentences.en: he assured a former business associate that the Trump administration would rip up economic sanctions imposed by President Obama against Russia,
sentences.zh: 他向一位前商业伙伴保证，特朗普政府将撕毁奥巴马总统对俄罗斯实施的经济制裁，

sentences.en: potentially allowing a business project he was once involved in to move forward.
sentences.zh: 这可能允许他曾参与的一个商业项目得以推进。

sentences.en: I, Donald John Trump, do solemnly swear.
sentences.zh: 我，唐纳德·约翰·特朗普，庄严宣誓。

sentences.en: I, Donald John Trump, do solemnly swear.
sentences.zh: 我，唐纳德·约翰·特朗普，庄严宣誓。

sentences.en: The whistleblower, who gave his account to Democratic Representative Elijah Cummings, says Flynn sent an encouraging text message to the client from the steps of the Capitol
sentences.zh: 这位将陈述提供给民主党众议员伊莱贾·卡明斯的举报人称，弗林在国会山台阶上向客户发送了一条鼓舞人心的短信，

sentences.en: as he watched Donald Trump take the oath of office on January 20th.
sentences.zh: 当时他正看着唐纳德·特朗普于1月20日宣誓就职。

sentences.en: So help me God.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝助我。

sentences.en: Congratulations, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你，总统先生。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the removal of the sanctions would have allowed Flynn's former client, an energy consulting firm,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，解除制裁将使弗林的前客户——一家能源咨询公司——

sentences.en: to work with Russia on a nuclear power deal, and suggests Flynn may have had a financial incentive to create a closer relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 得以与俄罗斯合作开展核能交易，并暗示弗林可能出于经济动机来与俄罗斯建立更紧密的关系。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: There were new allegations today, and enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 今天出现了新的指控，够了真是够了。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a conversation we've been having for a very long time, and it's a conversation that this country needs to have.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们已经进行了很长时间的对话，这也是这个国家需要进行的对话。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, after a sixth woman came forward with allegations of unwanted sexual advances by Senator Al Franken,
sentences.zh: 周三，在第六名女性站出来指控参议员阿尔·弗兰肯对其进行不受欢迎的性骚扰后，

sentences.en: much of the Democratic establishment called on him to resign, including dozens of Senate and House members, many of them women.
sentences.zh: 民主党建制派的大部分人呼吁他辞职，其中包括数十名参众两院议员，其中许多是女性。

sentences.en: If you are a sexual harasser, go away.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个性骚扰者，滚开。

sentences.en: We don't want you.
sentences.zh: 我们不欢迎你。

sentences.en: We don't want you as our colleague.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望你成为我们的同僚。

sentences.en: You know, our interns don't deserve that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们的实习生不该遭受这种对待。

sentences.en: Our staff doesn't deserve it.
sentences.zh: 我们的员工不该遭受这种对待。

sentences.en: The women members of Congress don't deserve it.
sentences.zh: 国会的女议员们不该遭受这种对待。

sentences.en: Franken, who has apologized for his behavior, has scheduled a news conference to discuss his political future later today.
sentences.zh: 弗兰肯已为其行为道歉，并已安排在今天晚些时候召开新闻发布会，讨论他的政治未来。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》中，我是主持人萨拉·科尼格，这里讲述的是那些试图维持自身影响力却在过程中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
